_comment: Copy this to usage-config.json (or point USAGE_CONFIG at your own file) and edit. All keys are OPTIONAL — with no config the tool still works, showing bare project names. 'workspace_roots': directory names directly under your home whose children are shown as bare project names, e.g. with 'Developer' listed, ~/Developer/myapp shows as 'myapp'. Add the roots where you keep repos (e.g. 'code', 'src', 'projects'). 'renames': map a bare project name (what's shown after stripping) to a nicer display name; point several bare names at the same display name to group them.
